nureongi.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, production game sprite animation. Match the supplied ACTUAL MapleStory game monster reference: compact chibi proportions, simple expressive face, hard filled pixel clusters with2-3shades, thin continuous dark charcoal outline1native pixel. No realistic animal, no 3D, no thick black sticker border, no smooth painted gradients, no light bloom. SAME identity, proportions, head volume, marking locations, outline thickness and body size in EVERY FRAME. Genuine transparent alpha, NO backgrounds/shadows/labels/grid/text. A single PNG1536x1280, exactly SIX columns by FIVE rows=30 equal256square cells. Each cell is a64x64 native sprite enlarged4x nearest, with at least5native pixels empty margin on each side. Entire anatomy and separate small effects stay inside each cell, never cross neighboring cells. Ground-contact baseline native y=54, body root near(32,42); flying head/bib register(30,33). Do not change camera scale between poses. Draw true anatomical frame changes, NOT stretched/rotated copies.
Character: NUREONGI, a village tan/yellow dog replacing the dark gray feral dog in the reference. Preserve its recognizably MapleStory short quadruped body, large expressive head, triangular ears, four short attached legs, curled tail and low lively stance. Change fur completely to warm GOLDEN TAN, cream muzzle/chest/paws, small darker ochre ear tips/back fur, BLACK nose and dark eyes, subtle reddish brown collar, no spikes/armor/bones. Cute alert village dog, not wolf, no canine body part missing. Facing threequarterLEFT in neutral motions; ATTACK is a short forward/downward bite TOWARD CAMERA, not a slash to left. No leftward swipe streak. Head volume does not shrink or grow when turning, muzzle projects slightly toward viewer.
ROW1 idle6: grounded quadruped breathing, blink, tiny tail wag, all four feet coherent.
ROW2 walk/run6: complete balanced six-phase quadruped gait, near and far forelegs/hindlegs separately attached, no extra feet, stable torso/round head.
ROW3 melee bite6:1 crouch with all four paws;2 weight shifts back, muzzle turns a little toward viewer;3 short forward pounce with near forepaws reaching downscreen;4 mouth opens briefly in frontal threequarter chomp toward viewer, head same size, two forelegs forward and attached;5 forefeet land, jaws close;6 regain neutral four-paw stance. Limit drawn lift to4native pixels; engine adds subtle depth lunge. No disembodied jaws or huge extended arms, no red blood.
ROW4 hit6: startle/recoil, eyes close then recover, face stays same size; body stays opaque, no flicker/invisible frames.
ROW5 defeat6: startled, knees bend, lowers, closes eyes, curls onto belly, final resting low dog with body/legs/tail intact. No disappearing body.
